Correct; the director's own 6161223570 on #23396 already has this shape.
- `references/lanes/director.md:25` — 「呈报的代价列旁恒带工作量列(…)」 becomes 「聊天呈批逐卡六项,取材 = 卡面分析 + 本席增量;增量点名复核了什么,⛔ 不复述所同意的。」: the card's change 2 (the chat batch keeps six items per card, built from the card's analysis plus the delta) and change 3 (the delta names what it re-checked, not what it agrees with). 120 bytes, at the cap. Correct.
- Deletions, read against the head: the old `decision-analysis.md:8` 「内部工具卡(dev 派发用)四维照旧,⛔ 不强加行业类比;只适用新记录,存量 ⛔ 不回改」 — its scope clause is the file's own `:7` (「只约束 `needs-user-decision` 卡与决策箱讨论的四维分析」 leaves tool cards outside this file), its new-records-only clause is `SKILL.md:96` (「四维中文只管新记录…存量中文 ⛔ 不追溯改写」), and the four-axis obligation on dispatch cards lives in `dispatch-runbook.md:205–209` (the block is pasted into every dispatch) — nothing leaves the corpus. The old `director.md:25` workload-column rule — `decision-analysis.md:25–26` define the 选项 × 代价 × 工作量 table and the 工作量 formula (车道 · 阶段/PR 数 · 实测先例 or 「无先例」), and `director.md:13` still reads the ruling's workload from 卡面工作量列; the new `:25` builds the chat batch from the card's analysis, which carries that column. Nothing leaves the corpus.
- Untouched, as the card requires: the 四棱 block, `Prior rulings read:`, and the ruling record's shape (`director.md:11–13` — the fixed first line, `Ruled:` on the body, the workload line). No `SKILL.md`, no `landing-operations.md` (#23381's), no `scripts/**`.
